text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Right now, I am offering detailed explanations
of the "Deserted Island Project" to anyone interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
<username>, 
do you need an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Now then, what would you like me to explain?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of what I wanted to ask regarding
training for the Deserted Island Project—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You'd like to know about the Deserted Island Project, then.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Deserted Island Project is a project to cultivate an uninhabited island, construct training facilities amidst nature,
and create the ultimate training environment!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "In this project, a total of 5 'evaluation meetings' will be held to review the island's development progress."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The construction progress will advance according to the Development Pts earned during the period leading up to each evaluation session.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If you raise your construction progress and complete the construction plan within the timeframe, you'll receive a high rating at the evaluation meeting!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To earn as many Development Points as possible,
be sure to train efficiently
and enter races♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, while participating in the Twinkle Series, everyone will also be taking part in the Deserted Island Project.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that depending on training conditions,
your training may conclude even while participating
in the Deserted Island PJ!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation
regarding the Deserted Island Project.
Is there anything else you would like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You'd like to hear about the "Construction Plan," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"In preparation for the semi-annual evaluation meeting,
we will formulate a construction plan to decide
which facilities to build and in what order during this period!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: In the construction plan, you will decide which facilities to build and the order of construction from six types of training facilities, all within a set budget.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "Your choice of 'Facility to Construct' will affect the efficacy of 'Island Training'—a special training program—as well as your regular training."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "Your choice of 'Construction Order' affects which facility effects are activated during Island Training."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Each facility has a Level and a Cost,
and leveling up a facility
will enhance its effects!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, the required cost might also
increase accordingly.
Keep the costs in mind when making your plan!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, you cannot raise the level of the same facility
by 2 or more within a single construction plan.
Please keep that in mind!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation regarding the 'Construction Plan.'
Is there anything else you would like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "Regarding ‘Development Pt,’ is it?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Facilities on Tracen Island are constructed based on the insights gained by Umamusume through their training and races!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The indicator measuring the progress of this project is called Development Points.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"You can earn Development Points through regular training,
running in races, or doing 'Island Training'♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Earning Development Points will advance the construction plan,
building new facilities while also granting you 'Island Training Tickets' to train on the island."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And one more thing! Please make sure to earn
plenty of Development Pts before
the "Evaluation Meeting"!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Not only will you receive a great score at the review board,
but it also promotes the growth of the Umamusume♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation
regarding 'Development Pt.'
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You'd like to know about "Island Training," correct?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By earning "Development Pts",
you can obtain "Island Training Tickets".

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By using an Island Training Ticket, you can perform
a new form of training, "Island Training,"
utilizing the deserted island's training facilities!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Island Training reflects the effects of facilities
whose construction was completed at the time
the Island Training Ticket was obtained.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Let's carefully consider the order of construction.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Additionally, the facilities where the Umamusume who train with you appear correspond to their usual training locations.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"However, if the corresponding facility has not
been constructed, that is not the case.
Please keep that in mind."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Island Training is fantastic, but it can only
be used when you have an Island Training Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, outside of special periods,
you can only hold 1 Island Training Ticket at a time...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"If you accept the second one,
your first Island Training Ticket will expire.
Please be careful!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation
regarding the Island Training.
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any time
by tapping the 'i' button in the top left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck.
I'll be cheering you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best,
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
